decisions: Strict event cutoff versus late tolerance
Should a scheduled retry be allowed after event-minus-10-days when it was due before cutoff? Current _work permits bounded late dispatch.
Current due<=deadline logic can dispatch at deadline before flagging. Confirm intended policy.
Current event_starts_at uses UTC midnight. Confirm venue-local versus UTC cutoff interpretation.
Confirm suppression or rewording rules for already queued reminders.
Confirm retry stop and financial reconciliation policy for these event states.
